$$
\chi' = \sum_{i=1}^n k_i s_i^2
$$

## Interactive Slice Cost Explorer

Adjust the resource allocation ($s_i$) and priority weight ($k_i$) for each RAN slice and watch the cost function $\chi' = \sum_i k_i s_i^2$ update live.

```{=html}
<style>
  .slice-explorer { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; max-width: 720px; margin: 1.5rem 0; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #d7dbe0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fafbfc; }
  .slice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr 60px 1fr 60px; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
  .slice-row label { font-weight: 600; }
  .slice-row input[type="range"] { width: 100%; }
  .slice-row output { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }
  .slice-explorer .controls { margin: 1rem 0; }
  .slice-explorer button { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; margin-right: 0.5rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #c6cbd1; background: #eef1f4; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
  .slice-explorer button:hover { background: #e2e6ea; }
  .slice-explorer .bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1.2rem; height: 140px; margin: 1rem 0; }
  .slice-explorer .bar-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; height: 100%; width: 70px; }
  .slice-explorer .bar { width: 100%; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; transition: height 0.15s ease; }
  .slice-explorer .bar-label { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.85rem; }
  .slice-explorer .cost-display { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 0.75rem; }
  .slice-explorer .cost-display span { color: #1a6ed8; }
</style>

<div class="slice-explorer" id="slice-explorer">
  <div class="slice-row">
    <label for="s1">eMBB s₁</label>
    <input type="range" id="s1" min="0" max="100" value="50">
    <output id="s1-out">50</output>
    <input type="range" id="k1" min="0" max="5" step="0.1" value="1">
    <output id="k1-out">k₁ = 1.0</output>
  </div>
  <div class="slice-row">
    <label for="s2">URLLC s₂</label>
    <input type="range" id="s2" min="0" max="100" value="50">
    <output id="s2-out">50</output>
    <input type="range" id="k2" min="0" max="5" step="0.1" value="1">
    <output id="k2-out">k₂ = 1.0</output>
  </div>
  <div class="slice-row">
    <label for="s3">mMTC s₃</label>
    <input type="range" id="s3" min="0" max="100" value="50">
    <output id="s3-out">50</output>
    <input type="range" id="k3" min="0" max="5" step="0.1" value="1">
    <output id="k3-out">k₃ = 1.0</output>
  </div>

  <div class="controls">
    <button id="randomize-btn" type="button">🎲 Randomize</button>
    <button id="reset-btn" type="button">↺ Reset</button>
  </div>

  <div class="bars">
    <div class="bar-wrap"><div class="bar" id="bar1" style="background:#1a6ed8;"></div><div class="bar-label">eMBB</div></div>
    <div class="bar-wrap"><div class="bar" id="bar2" style="background:#e0673d;"></div><div class="bar-label">URLLC</div></div>
    <div class="bar-wrap"><div class="bar" id="bar3" style="background:#2fa66a;"></div><div class="bar-label">mMTC</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="cost-display">χ' = <span id="cost-out">0</span></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const ids = [1, 2, 3];
  const els = {};
  ids.forEach(function (i) {
    els['s' + i] = document.getElementById('s' + i);
    els['k' + i] = document.getElementById('k' + i);
    els['s' + i + 'out'] = document.getElementById('s' + i + '-out');
    els['k' + i + 'out'] = document.getElementById('k' + i + '-out');
    els['bar' + i] = document.getElementById('bar' + i);
  });
  const costOut = document.getElementById('cost-out');
  const defaults = { s1: 50, k1: 1, s2: 50, k2: 1, s3: 50, k3: 1 };

  function recompute() {
    let cost = 0;
    ids.forEach(function (i) {
      const s = parseFloat(els['s' + i].value);
      const k = parseFloat(els['k' + i].value);
      els['s' + i + 'out'].textContent = s.toFixed(0);
      els['k' + i + 'out'].textContent = 'k' + i + ' = ' + k.toFixed(1);
      els['bar' + i].style.height = s + '%';
      cost += k * s * s;
    });
    costOut.textContent = cost.toFixed(1);
  }

  ids.forEach(function (i) {
    els['s' + i].addEventListener('input', recompute);
    els['k' + i].addEventListener('input', recompute);
  });

  document.getElementById('randomize-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    ids.forEach(function (i) {
      els['s' + i].value = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);
      els['k' + i].value = (Math.random() * 5).toFixed(1);
    });
    recompute();
  });

  document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    ids.forEach(function (i) {
      els['s' + i].value = defaults['s' + i];
      els['k' + i].value = defaults['k' + i];
    });
    recompute();
  });

  recompute();
})();
</script>
```
